requirement: A complete .yml project file round-trips through load_config without error
rationale: Confirms the parser accepts all valid fields without silent data loss

requirement: load_config raises SystemExit when the [sweep] section is absent
rationale: Missing sweep section makes the file unusable; fail-fast with a clear error is better than a downstream AttributeError

requirement: load_config raises SystemExit when the [input] section is absent
rationale: Missing input section means no geometry file can be located

requirement: load_config raises SystemExit when alpha is an empty list
rationale: An empty alpha sweep would produce no .st files silently

requirement: load_config raises SystemExit when beta is an empty list
rationale: An empty beta sweep would produce no .st files silently

requirement: load_config raises SystemExit for an unrecognised output format
rationale: Unknown format cannot be written; failing fast avoids a silent no-op after a full sweep

requirement: load_config raises SystemExit when a ctrl_sweeps entry is an empty list
rationale: An empty deflection list silently omits that surface from the sweep

requirement: load_config raises SystemExit for non-numeric alpha values
rationale: Non-numeric values cannot be passed to AVL; early error avoids a downstream traceback

requirement: load_config raises SystemExit for syntactically invalid YAML
rationale: Malformed YAML is always a user error; fail-fast with a clear message

requirement: ProjectConfig defaults output.format to csv and ctrl_sweeps to empty dict when omitted
rationale: Sensible defaults reduce boilerplate in simple project files

requirement: SweepSpec emits a UserWarning when a ctrl_sweeps entry omits 0.0
rationale: 0.0 is required for neutral aero tables; silently omitting it corrupts stab tables

requirement: SweepSpec inserts 0.0 into ctrl_sweeps entries that omit it
rationale: Auto-insertion ensures stab tables are always populated without requiring the user to know why

requirement: input.geometry is resolved relative to the .yml file's directory
rationale: Geometry and .yml travel together; relative paths survive moving the project directory

requirement: CLI sweep writes output to _runs/<yml-stem>/ one directory above the .yml
rationale: Keeps generated outputs out of the geometry directory without requiring an explicit out_dir argument

requirement: CLI sweep passes alpha / beta / ctrl_sweeps / out_dir / out_format correctly to avl_sweep.run
rationale: Ensures config fields are not silently dropped or transformed between YAML parse and AVL invocation

requirement: CLI sweep exits with error when a ctrl_sweeps key is not a valid surface name in the .avl
rationale: Typos in the .yml would silently sweep with no deflections applied

requirement: CLI plot geometry calls avl_fileplot with the parsed geometry
rationale: Confirms the command wires geometry parsing to the plotting function without silent skips

requirement: CLI plot geometry writes <avl-stem>_geometry.html to the .avl file's directory
rationale: Predictable output path keeps the plot alongside the geometry file it depicts

requirement: CLI plot aero auto-selects the latest timestamped subdirectory when given a parent directory
rationale: Avoids requiring users to type full timestamps for the most common case of plotting the most recent run

requirement: CLI plot aero accepts a specific run directory directly
rationale: Enables reproducible re-plotting of any historical run

requirement: CLI plot aero exits with error when no sweep results exist in the given directory
rationale: Prevents a silent empty plot when the sweep has not been run or the path is wrong

requirement: CLI plot aero exits with error when the given directory does not exist
rationale: Catches path typos before attempting to read results

requirement: CLI plot aero resolves run directories named <avl-stem>_<timestamp> (prefixed timestamp pattern)
rationale: Run directories include the geometry name as a prefix; the auto-latest logic must match this pattern

requirement: CLI plot aero accepts a directory containing a .raw/ subdirectory directly without searching for a parent
rationale: Supports direct paths to known run directories bypassing the auto-latest search

requirement: CLI plot aero writes stab.html and ctrl_<coef>.html to the run directory
rationale: Predictable filenames enable scripted post-processing and the index.html link list

requirement: _write_index_html creates an index.html listing all .html files in the directory
rationale: Provides a single entry point for reviewing all plots from a run in a browser

requirement: All shipped example .yml files parse without error
rationale: Ensures examples remain valid as the config schema evolves

requirement: ctrl_sweeps keys in example .yml files all match surface names in the corresponding .avl
rationale: Prevents shipping broken examples that would error at runtime

requirement: End-to-end: CLI verify returns exit code 0 with the real AVL binary installed
rationale: Confirms the full binary-discovery and health-check path works against the actual installed binary

requirement: End-to-end: CLI sweep produces results.csv and provenance.json in a timestamped run directory with the correct case count
rationale: Full pipeline smoke test from .yml config through AVL execution to structured output files

requirement: End-to-end: CLI plot geometry writes <avl-stem>_geometry.html to the .avl directory
rationale: Confirms the geometry plot command runs without error against a real geometry file

requirement: End-to-end: CLI plot aero writes stab.html and ctrl_CLtot.html after a real sweep
rationale: Confirms the aero plot command correctly finds the latest run and produces all output HTML files

requirement: End-to-end: Python API chain (avl_fileread → avl_fileplot → avl_sweep → aero_filewrite → aero_fileplot) produces 9 results with CLtot in every case
rationale: Smoke test confirming every public API function works in sequence against the real AVL binary
